newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Australian PM leaves Indonesia for Japan.
newsitem.headline: Australian PM leaves Indonesia for Japan.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard left Jakarta for Tokyo on Wednesday after his first official visit which focussed on economic relations rather than Indonesia's domestic political problems.
An embassy official said Howard and his group boarded Cathy Pacific flight CX718 to Hong Kong where they would make a brief transit before flying on to Tokyo.
An airline official said the flight took off slightly behind schedule at 9.12 a.m. (0212 GMT).
The conservative leader arrived on Monday for his first official visit to Indonesia since taking office six months ago.
"It is important to Australia that this be a visit which allows both President Suharto and myself to affirm the importance of the relationship," Howard said on Tuesday.

Howard said he had spoken mostly about economic matters in his 90 minute official meeting with Indonesian President Suharto, avoiding contentious isssues such as human rights and the situation in East Timor.
"I did not come here to give lectures," he said.
